basic_details.short_information: Kerala Public Service Commission (Kerala PSC) has released recruitment opportunities for various posts across different departments in 2026. The recruitment includes vacancies for Assistant Professors, Assistant Engineers, Teachers, Technical Assistants, Clerical posts, Police posts, Forest posts and other positions under Kerala Government departments.

content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Kerala Public Service Commission has officially released Category No. 73/2026 TO 128/2026 for recruitment to 40 Junior Clerk, Assistant Engineer and More Posts posts. The notification includes complete details, district-wise vacancies, eligibility, physical standards, medical certificate format, age limit, selection process, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to download and read the full notification and its annexures before applying online. The notification PDF is available on the official Kerala PSC website. content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process will be conducted as per the rules and regulations of Travancore Titanium Products Ltd. If a Written / OMR / Online Test is conducted as part of the selection, only candidates possessing the requisite qualifications will be allowed to appear. Candidates will be advised from the Ranked List prepared in the order of merit. The Ranked List will remain in force for a minimum period of one year and a maximum period of three years . Kerala PSC reserves the right to cancel the advice for appointment of any candidate if any mistake is found later. Final selection is subject to verification of original documents and medical fitness.

faq.question: Q1. What is Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by Kerala Public Service Commission for various posts under different Kerala Government departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 includes multiple vacancies across various departments. The vacancy count varies according to each post.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available under Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Assistant Professor, Assistant Engineer, Teacher, Lecturer, Technical Assistant, Clerk, Police Constable, Forest Watcher and other posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The required qualification varies according to the post. Candidates may require SSLC, ITI, Diploma, Degree, Engineering Degree, Postgraduate Degree, M.Ch, MD, DNB, MDS or other specified qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit differs for each post. The general age range mentioned for various posts is between 18 and 50 years depending on the position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary depends on the post. The pay scale ranges from Rs. 17,400 - 46,450/- to Rs. 56,500 - 1,18,100/- for different positions. Assistant Professor posts will receive salary as per UGC norms.
